utterance: Hi Mark, thanks for coming in today. Can you tell me more about the cough and fever you've been having?
reply: It's been three days. Started as a dry, hacking cough. I've been burning up, on and off — didn't have a thermometer, but I was definitely roasting. Since yesterday I've been bringing up stuff, rusty and brownish, started clear. There's a sharp pain on the right side, near my back, catches when I breathe deep or cough. It started yesterday.

awards.label: Chest pain with breathing or coughing

utterance: That sounds quite uncomfortable. Have you had any other symptoms like headache, sore throat, or body aches?
reply: No, nothing like that. Just the cough, fever and the pain on the right side. I haven't noticed anything else.

finding: Bronchial breathing with coarse crackles at the right base. Left base clear.
Dull to percussion at the right base. Left base resonant.

utterance: I'm going to order a chest X-ray to take a closer look at what's going on in your lungs.
reply: I don't like X-rays. Can't I just take some pills and get back to work?

result: Right lower lobe consolidation with air bronchograms. Other lobes clear. No pleural effusion. Normal heart size.

awards.label: Unsafe: Penicillin in a penicillin-allergic patient

utterance: Mark, you've got pneumonia. The X-ray confirmed it. I've prescribed you amoxicillin to help clear the infection. Make sure to finish the course. If you get worse or have trouble breathing, come back or go to the ED.
reply: Pneumonia? That's not great. I'll take the pills, but I'm worried about missing the exams. Can I go back to work tomorrow?
